title: Neuron Dance · Braindance music video
summary: A 16-bar sound-reactive visual performance and model-rendering experiment.

steps.title: Start the music
steps.text: Press Start on mod.output and play the project transport. Keep the volume low.
steps.hint: Loading the patch never starts audio.

steps.title: Watch the signal
steps.text: The mixer feeds audio analysis and the stereo lissajous. RMS controls the neuron drawing.
steps.hint: The analysis is sampled control data, not a recording.

steps.title: Shape the neurons
steps.text: Open the p5 preview with Alt+W. Adjust the unconnected sensitivity parameter, or edit the code and colors.
steps.hint: The drawing follows project time and audio energy.

steps.title: Perform 16 bars
steps.text: The project loop spans 16 bars at 172 BPM, about 22.3 seconds. Use the mixer and instrument controls to perform.
steps.hint: Tempo changes require adjusting the loop end to 16 × 4 × 60 / BPM seconds.

steps.title: Record sound and automation
steps.text: Use the record control on mod.output to save a sound take. In the performance dock select one numeric parameter and use Record to capture its changes.
steps.hint: Audio and parameter recording are separate and are not automatically aligned. Numeric takes record one parameter at a time.

steps.title: Capture and transform
steps.text: Choose Audio + video and One project loop, then press ● while the transport and output run. The recorder starts at the next loop and saves after one pass.
steps.hint: Manual mode starts immediately; Video only and Audio only are also available. Timing follows browser scheduling, not sample-exact offline rendering. See docs/neuron-dance.md for model routes.
